notes.title: Version 2.0.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I uploaded the new version 2.0.0.5 of LUISOAC, here are the changes:


 Added support for an easier way of reporting bugs, you can find more information in the discussion here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1742930/discussions/0/4695658043402124761/
 Fixes.

As regards the requested languages: I hope I can add them soon, thank you for your patience!

As always, thanks for your messages and your continuous support! 🍀

notes.title: Version 2.0.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I uploaded the new version 2.0.0.4 of LUISOAC, here are the changes:


 Fixes;
 Localization fixes.

I updated the "Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling (Original Soundtrack)" files with a better format that should allow you to listen to them also from the Steam Music Player without issues.
The DLC's OSTs are coming soon: working on setting up the Steam page and other music platforms pages.

I am also looking into the new bugs shared in the discussions: thanks for the patience and for playing! 🍀
